name: Civic Connect Lite
author: Remco Van Latum

sections.description:
Civic Connect Lite by Humble Consultancy is a high-performance identification tool that allows website visitors to find their legislators based on their zip code.

Lite Version Features:
* Instant representative identification (Name, Party, and District).
* Modern, responsive interface.
* Optimized for WordPress 6.9 and beyond.

External services

This plugin connects to the 5 Calls API (https://api.5calls.org) to provide users with up-to-date information about their political representatives based on their location.

  • Data sent: The plugin sends the user’s zip code or location string to the 5 Calls API when a search is performed.
  • Purpose: To fetch and display local representative names, districts, and contact information.
  • Privacy & Terms: This service is provided by 5 Calls. Their privacy policy can be found at: https://5calls.org/privacy and terms of use at: https://5calls.org/terms.

Why Upgrade to Pro?
Civic Connect Lite is a discovery tool. To turn discovery into action, upgrade to Civic Connect Pro to unlock:
* Direct Contact Details: View official phone numbers, websites, and office addresses.
* Official Portraits: High-quality photos for every representative.
* Custom Branding: Color pickers to match the tool to your organization’s brand.
* Premium Layout: High-fidelity “Representative Cards” for a professional advocacy experience.

Learn more and upgrade at Humble Consultancy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the civic-connect-lite folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Add your 5 Calls API token in the ‘Civic Connect’ admin menu.
  4. Use [civic_lookup] to display the search form.
